name: Kimi no Moto e...
source:
A new company "Virtual World EXP" provides a revolutionary simulated experience with all five senses. Main character is going to test the system for 21 day. Will he choose virtual avatars of real girls or try to build relations with artificial intelligence girl "Anon"?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一家名为“Virtual World EXP”的新公司提供一种革命性的模拟体验，可以重现人的五种感官。主角将对这套系统进行为期21天的测试。他会选择现实女孩的虚拟化身，还是尝试与人工智能女孩“阿农”建立关系？

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
